XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='HdmMfnM02:MFN_M02' targetDocType='VyncaMfnM02:MFN_M02' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for MSPR Provider and Non-Provider HL7 to Sunquest</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"VYNCA"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication}' action='set' /> <assign value='"MFN"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.messagetype}' action='set' /> <assign value='"02"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MFI}' property='target.{MFI}' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.{MFEgrp()}' key='k1' > <assign value='source.{MFEgrp(k1).MFE}' property='target.{MFEgrp(k1).MFE}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MFEgrp(k1).STF}' property='target.{MFEgrp(k1).STF}' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{MFEgrp(k1).STF:PrimaryKeyValueSTF.identifier}' action='clear' /> <assign value='context.isMsprPersonIdInMspr' property='target.{MFEgrp(k1).STF:PrimaryKeyValueSTF.identifier}' action='set' /> <trace value='"Person ID populated in STF-1.1: " _context.isMsprPersonIdInMspr' /> <assign value='source.{MFEgrp(k1).PRA}' property='target.{MFEgrp(k1).PRA}' action='set' /> <trace value='"The Cerner Primary Position value from LDAP mapped to PRA-7.1 -->" _context.VyncaRoleFromLdap' /> </foreach> <trace value='"**********************End of DTL**************************"' /> </transform>
